personality.description: This person usually sticks to familiar routines, prefers proven methods, and is cautious about trying unfamiliar approaches. They keep a moderate level of order in daily habits, maintaining enough structure to function well while still allowing some flexibility when needed. In moral dilemmas, they tend to first worry about the emotional impact on others, avoid confrontation, and seek a solution that preserves harmony, though they may ruminate afterward about whether they made the right choice. In group discussions, they speak quietly and selectively, listen carefully, and are more likely to contribute after reflection or in a small, comfortable setting rather than in a lively debate.
